full_judgment: Having regard to these facts and. circumstances and out discussions above, we direct the respondents to restore vacant possession of the premises situated on Plot No. 7774 under Khatian No. 8 of Mouza Sylhet within the Municipal Town of Sylhet popularly known as Sylhet Government Pilot High School Muslim Hostel to the petitioner within four weeks from date. We have also considered the question of costs to be awarded in the facts and circumstances of a case like this. We feel that exemplary cost should be awarded against the respondents for their illegal action in the matter and further for their failure to avail of the opportunities given to correct them. We accordingly direct the respondents to pay to the petitioner Taka 10,000/00 (Taka Ten thousand) as costs.
